ci_scope: paired bootstrap on repeated measurements and two fixed holdout seeds; not a population claim or independent reproduction
classification: Bounded construction-plus-linear-reduction engineering diagnostic. Complete polynomial solving, Groebner iteration/root extraction, full IC operations and rho ratio remain null. The full thread goal remains open unless evidence covers that broader scope.
counter_scope: Count logical row XORs and executed u64 XORs in the shared reducer, including backward elimination. Logical row-XOR counts must agree across arms on matched inputs; word counts may differ with coordinate width. These are reduction-phase diagnostics, not complete calibrated operation costs.
memory_scope: Retained context capacity bytes exclude allocator metadata. basis_max_bytes is the maximum across inputs of basis storage at the end of insertion, before backward elimination; it is not total peak memory and excludes incoming row and output-compaction temporaries. Whole-worker RSS includes every arm and the reference corpus. auxiliary_max_bytes records the maximum incidence-mask/list capacity storage at preparation over the batch. It excludes later nonzero-cache growth and is not process peak memory. Incidence reducer basis storage includes nonzero-word lists at the end of insertion.
projection_scope: A construction-only zero-time projection holds all other measured phases fixed: total_ns / (total_ns - construction_ns), evaluated on sorted_reduce. This is a diagnostic counterfactual, not a bound on coupled implementations or full solving.
scope: Standalone generic Boolean degree-3 construction plus canonical GF2 reduced-row-space computation. This is a complete bounded linear-algebra workload, not complete Groebner closure or polynomial solving. No production solver integration, curve inputs, scalar recovery, relation campaigns or rho runs.
